additional_info.body:
Hello Ferdinand,
Hope you are doing great.
As per our analysis QA13-QA14 needs to check if faulty needs to replace (notes added in timeline), we
recommend manually inspecting the contactors. If any faults are detected in the contactors, please proceed with replacing them.
There are two preconditions to start the SMC selftest:
All converters report power off state
The outgoing coils are open
As per the DC_Coils_MG1-MG4_SelfTest, that means need to check all the contactor which we are using for flex configuration i.e
SMC1: QA11/QA12
SMC2: QA17/QA18
SMC3: QA15/QA16
status: failed, reason: smc[0,1,2,3]-[states]-[results]
status: failed, reason: smc[0,1,2,3]-[F,S,S,S]-[0,0,0,0] : in charger
So SMC0 : QA9/QA10
SMC1: QA11/QA12
SMC2: QA17/QA18
SMC3: QA15/QA16
In error code status [F,S,S,S]: denotes SMC0 contactor check  failed & SMC1,2,3 is skipped
[0,0,0,0]: denotes Contactor QA9/QA10 feedback is not received

additional_info.subject: RE: 0388778 - ID0388778-DC/Si-D/NZ-[qhDPeN] MG1-MG4_SelfTest CRM:00312000035
additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Hope you are doing well.
Are you able to reach out to the customer to understand when the vehicle is not connected to the charger?
Our global team would like to do some additional remote testing and monitoring by rebooting the charger, during which a vehicle should not be connected.
We have also checked local stock and if a site intervention is required and confirmed by HQ, we will send over the remaining contactors in case they are needed.
As the first preventative maintenance was only carried out 13 months after installation of the charger (missing the 6 and 12 month maintenance schedules), warranty has been compromised in general.
If contactors are found to be defective, this will be covered under warranty.
If KF13 has the failure, as it was noted that the charger had substantial dust inside and the KF13 has openings, due to the lacking maintenance, it would not be covered.
However, in this exceptional case, we are willing to cover half of the component and labour cost for KF13 replacement on good will of understanding an effort for preventative maintenance was made, however in future cases where preventative maintenance is missed, it may not be covered under warranty.
We believe it is less likely to be a power module, however would you be able to confirm that the charger was put into operation at the latest, 12 months after the manufacture date (03/2022)?
If site visit is required, understanding the remote location of the site, would you prefer components be sent to your warehouse and then carried with the technician to the site? Or directly to the site?
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility
